POST Progress Image Generator

/api/progress-image

Generate custom progress report images with skills, XP gained, loot collected, and runtime data.

📋 Request Parameters

script_name string
Name of the script or activity (e.g., "Seers Agility", "Herblore Training")
runtime number
Runtime in minutes (must be positive)
loot array
Array of items collected during the session
[ { "id": 17, // Item ID (number) "name": "Grail bell", // Item name (optional) "count": 36 // Quantity obtained (number) } ]
xp_earned array
Array of XP gained per skill during the session
[ { "skill": "strength", // Skill name (string) "xp": "42,069" // XP gained (string with commas) } ]

📤 Example Request

{ "script_name": "Herblore Training Session", "runtime": 75, "loot": [ {"id": 91, "name": "Guam potion (unf)", "count": 84}, {"id": 199, "name": "Grimy guam leaf", "count": 5}, {"id": 207, "name": "Grimy ranarr weed", "count": 44} ], "xp_earned": [ {"skill": "herblore", "xp": "15,420"}, {"skill": "farming", "xp": "2,100"} ] }

📥 Response Format

Returns a JSON object containing the generated image data:

{ "success": true, "imageUrl": "data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAA...", "metadata": { "script_name": "Herblore Training Session", "runtime": 75, "total_loot_items": 3, "total_xp_gained": 17520, "skills_trained": ["herblore", "farming"] } }

📸 Sample Output

The generated image includes:

  • Script name and runtime
  • XP gained per skill with skill icons
  • Items looted with quantities and icons
  • Professional OSRS-style formatting
  • High-quality PNG format suitable for sharing

⚠️ Error Responses

400 - Validation Error

{ "error": true, "statusCode": 400, "message": "Validation Error", "data": [ { "code": "invalid_type", "expected": "string", "received": "undefined", "path": ["script_name"], "message": "Script name is required" } ] }

500 - Server Error

{ "error": true, "statusCode": 500, "message": "Failed to generate progress image" }
